payload.summary: Check the live Tall Man drug lettering list against the ACSQHC National Tall Man list
payload.detail: src/lib/medications/tall-man.ts is live on medication search and record pages but was never checked against the official list. Doubtful: citaloPRAM/escitaloPRAM and fluPENtixol/zucloPENthixol capitalise the shared stem so they do not separate the pair, CLONazepam differs from ISMP clonazePAM, and VALproate, midazolAM, temazePAM, oxazePAM need checking. Matching is exact-name only. Needs owner verification.
